K1 schema rejects the inherited keys toString/hasOwnProperty/valueOf/constructor/isPrototypeOf and pins the 40/41 key boundary; kill proof: ({}).toString is truthy, so only the key allowlist plus the Object.prototype refine stop these. K3 a ../ clip value yields no play and shows the alert; kill proof: no play src contains '..', which kills a base-URL concatenation design. K4 twenty rapid taps reuse one clip element (playing max 1) and leave no timer after ended. K5 a mode switch during a clip keeps the pinned invariants (sentence file plays, exactly one mode pressed showing Playing, no alert); the clip-stays-playing observation is the nonblocking finding above. K6 a clip with no signed URL shows the alert and Read it to me still plays the sentence file. K7 clips on the decodable book list with kind word-clip in receive-weeks mediaOf and create no tap target and no play on the read-along page (no cross-book leak).
